name: prompt-transform
description: An Optimize button above the prompt box (and /optimize) that rewrites your prompt and has Jev (TypeSafe) pick the model, effort and skill for it from a benchmark routing table, switching a long task from the planning model to a cheaper one mid-task; it also compacts a long thread, adds deny rules for files Claude never needs, switches off plugins no chat has used in 14 days and switches one on when a prompt needs it, and daily flags idle MCP servers, missing context-mode and RTK, and CLAUDE.md files over 200 lines; beside a one-bar meter of how warm the prompt cache is. It keeps Claude's skills up to date.
